question: At a point P, the direction of the electric field vector $\vec{E}$ is defined as:

options.A: The direction of the electrostatic force on a positive test charge placed at P.
options.B: From the nearest negative charge toward the nearest positive charge.
options.C: Dependent on the magnitude of the test charge used to measure it.
options.D: Zero unless a test charge is actually placed at P.
